versions.localizedDescription: Hawoo everywan its been half a year since the last release I'm really sorry because ever since beta build I got lazy from release a new version, anyway here's v1.6 with lots of fixes and improvements!

Hawwo everywan! the next big update is here! thank you for all your feature requests and bug reports!

This version introduces:

- Notification when signing finishes
- Improved UI and UX
- Various bug fixes and performance improvements

Hawwo everywan! the next big update is here! thank you for all your feature requests and bug reports!

This version introduces:

- Bulk Signing (select multiple apps and sign them all at once)
- Enhanced file management
- Performance improvements

Hallo everywan! small update and a new app icon!

## What's Changed
* New default app icon! This one can adapt to Dark Mode and Tint and way more clearly stands out from other apps!
* Bug fixes and stability improvements

Hallo everywan! A new update yay, a few big changes:

What's Changed
- Click on .ksign files will import to app automatically
- Apps in App Store tab now have better display
- Improved stability and performance

Hello everyone, a new update no way! What's new in this version:

What's Changed

Adjust 'Show Dylibs' to include injected dylibs located in the .app bundle
- Fixed various bugs and improved app stability
